proposal.reason: Main functional change is in CE/DMA execution and queue ownership: it separates CE memcpy rings from ltOki DMA rings, updates CE/OKI stream and QP ring assignment to avoid mixed AllGather+OKI AR/RS hangs, and fixes AR/RS DMA chunk-tail sizing/clamping. Shared init/enqueue edits are feature wiring for this same CE path, while added tests/Makefile are supporting validation only.
